title: 第十一章 洞窟传承第十章 铸魔洞窟
lines: 逆仙成魔传最新章节_第十一章 洞窟传承第1页_逆仙成魔传废个球_热点小说网
> 第十一章 洞窟传承（第1页）
“喂!石头你可知道那是什么”李磊伸手指向那个洞窟。
“嗯？什么？难道你能看见吗，也对，触发了三重天雷劫的人看不到这个才怪”石头感叹道。
于是石头便和李磊讲起了关于这洞窟的事。
此地乃是铸魔洞窟，顾名思义就是铸就妖魔鬼怪的地方。
虽然这地方散发着如此浓烈的魔气，但这铸魔洞窟诡异就诡异在只有将要参与洪荒量劫的人才有可能见到。
孙悟空是谁？他李磊能不知道，那可是送佛去西天取经的孙大圣啊，恐怕整个大唐都没有几个人说不知道的。
“那你一定听说过牛魔王，转轮王吧”
“他们能获得了那般成就都是因为这铸魔洞窟，只要进入铸魔洞窟就会获得强大的力量，就连魔祖罗睺也是从这铸魔洞窟获得了传承，不然他凭什么手段和那鸿钧斗，好了!现在咱们只要获得了铸魔洞窟的传承你的实力一定能突飞猛进的”石头兴奋的说道。
“我有说过我去吗，走了!我就知道这不是什么好地方，原来是成魔之地，晦气”李磊满脸嫌弃道，说完李磊便要继续前行。
“哎哎哎!我的小祖宗啊!能不能别任性了!虽然此地是成魔之地但获得力量又有什么错呢？我保证这里肯定没有什么坏处，这……这样吧，你去那洞窟中只取三样东西如……如何？就当是……是我求你了”
此时石头非常非常紧张，紧张的就连说话也都磕巴起来了，因为她生怕李磊放弃这大好机会离去。
“害!算了，服了!古人云，有便宜不占是傻子，得得得，我去还不行吗”
终于在石头软磨硬泡之下李磊终于肯前往铸魔洞窟一探究竟了。
从远处看只能看得见散发出浓烈魔气的铸魔洞窟以及那铸魔洞窟几个大字，只是走到了铸魔洞窟面前李磊却更是惊呆了。
虽然这洞窟看起来很小，但这洞窟上面却有无数暗紫色光华在铸魔洞窟附近徘徊，看起来更是增加了几分神秘色彩。
李磊走进观察了一下这刻着铸魔洞窟这几个大字，这几个大字虽然看起来很是随意，但却难以掩盖出这几个大字散发出的那种让人敬佩的威势，可以想象出刻这几个大字的人得有多么强大实力啊。
“石头你可知道这地方是何人所建”
“不知道，但我可以确定的是这铸魔洞窟盘古开天辟地的时候就有了”
听到这里李磊对这铸魔洞窟打量的就更加仔细了。
还没等李磊研究完这铸魔洞窟外表的神秘，这石头却开始催促起了李磊。
令李磊万万没想到的是本来从洞窟外面望向里面看什么都没有，但进入里面，整个洞内一种浓浓的紫色气体却充斥在了这个洞内，看起来甚是诡异。
只是还没等到李磊反应过来时，那充斥着满洞的气体仿佛是遇见了主人一样全都疯狂钻入李磊的鼻腔内，融入李磊的灵魂里。
一开始李磊拼命的捂住口鼻想要阻止这气体进入他的体内，只是他这么做却依然无济于事，只能任由这气体钻入体内。

> Chapter 11 Cave inheritance (page 1)
"Hey! Do you know what that stone is?" Li Lei pointed to the cave.
"Huh? What? Can you see it? That's right. It would be weird if the person who triggered the third-level thunder tribulation couldn't see this," Shitou sighed.
So Shitou told Li Lei about the cave.
This place is the Demon Casting Cave, as the name suggests, it is the place where demons and monsters are cast.
Although this place exudes such a strong demonic aura, the Demon Casting Cave is so weird that only those who will participate in the great calamity can see it.
Who is Sun Wukong? Li Lei could not know that he was Sun Dasheng who sent Buddha to the West to obtain Buddhist scriptures. I am afraid there are not many people in the entire Tang Dynasty who don't know.
"Then you must have heard of the Bull Demon King and the Wheel-turning King."
"They have achieved such achievements because of the Demon Casting Cave. As long as you enter the Demon Casting Cave, you will gain powerful power. Even the Demon Ancestor Luohu received his inheritance from the Demon Casting Cave. Otherwise, how would he have fought against Na Hongjun? Well! Now as long as we obtain the inheritance of the Demon Casting Cave, your strength will definitely improve by leaps and bounds," Shitou said excitedly.
"Did I say I'm going? Let's go! I knew this wasn't a good place. It turned out to be a place to become a demon. It's bad luck." Li Lei said with disgust on his face. After saying this, Li Lei moved on.
"Hey, hey! My little ancestor! Can you stop being willful! Although this is a place to become a demon, what's wrong with gaining strength? I promise there is no harm in this place. This... let's do this. How about you go to the cave and only take three things like...? Just treat it as... I'm begging you."
Shitou was very, very nervous at this time, so nervous that she even stuttered when speaking, because she was afraid that Li Lei would give up this great opportunity and leave.
"Harm! Forget it, accept it! As the ancients said, you are a fool if you don't take advantage of it. Come on, come on, why don't you let me go?"
Finally, after grinding the stone hard, Li Lei was finally willing to go to the Demon Casting Cave to find out.
From a distance, he could only see the Demon Casting Cave, which exuded a strong demonic aura, and the words "Demon Casting Cave". But when he walked to the Demon Casting Cave, Li Lei was even more shocked.
Although the cave looks small, there are countless dark purple rays of light lingering around the cave, which seems to add a bit of mystery.
Li Lei walked in and observed the large characters engraved with the words "Demon Casting Cave". Although these large characters looked very random, they could not conceal the admirable power exuded by these large characters. You can imagine how powerful the person who carved these large characters must be.
"Stone, do you know who built this place?"
"I don't know, but what I can confirm is that this Demon-casting Cave existed when Pangu created the world."
Hearing this, Li Lei looked at the Demon Casting Cave more carefully.
Before Li Lei could finish studying the mystery of the demon-casting cave's appearance, the stone began to urge Li Lei on.
What Li Lei never expected was that when he looked in from the outside of the cave, there was nothing there, but when he entered, a thick purple gas filled the entire cave, which looked very strange.
But before Li Lei could react, the gas that filled the hole crazily penetrated into Li Lei's nasal cavity and merged into Li Lei's soul, as if it had met its owner.
At first, Li Lei desperately covered his mouth and nose to prevent the gas from entering his body, but it was still to no avail and he could only let the gas penetrate into his body.
